subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC4 requires three specific test cases that could not be verified in the visible portion of the test file: (1) live_preview block present with preview_token when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is set, (2) live_preview absent when the token is unset, (3) setHost called with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST when set, taking priority over CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST. The visible tests cover addParam forwarding for getEntry (e.g., 'should forward live_preview.preview_hash to the query via addParam') but no tests were found that assert the `options` object contains `live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: ... }` when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is set, that `live_preview` is absent from `options` when the token is unset, or that `Stack.setHost` is called with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST taking priority over CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST. The existing 'contentstack fetch timeout' describe block tests the `options` object in this exact pattern — similar tests for live_preview options and setHost priority are expected but absent.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a describe block (e.g., 'live_preview configuration') with three tests mirroring the 'contentstack fetch timeout' pattern: (1) set process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN='test_preview_token', require the module, and assert `options.live_preview` equals `{ enable: true, preview_token: 'test_preview_token' }`; (2) unset CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, require the module, and assert `options` does not have a `live_preview` key; (3) set both CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST, require the module, and assert `Stack.setHost` was called with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST (not CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST).

issues.description: findSingletonEntry accepts IContentstackGetSingletonEntry (which extends ICommonContentstackConfig and therefore includes the optional live_preview field) but does not destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery. The preview context is silently dropped for all singleton entry queries, meaning draft content will not be fetched for singleton content types during live preview.
issues.suggestedFix: Destructure live_preview from the function parameters and pass it to createContentTypeQuery: `const { contentTypeUid, lang, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, except, where, live_preview } = ...` then add `live_preview` to the createContentTypeQuery call.

issues.description: getSingletonEntry has the same gap as findSingletonEntry — it accepts IContentstackGetSingletonEntry (which includes live_preview via ICommonContentstackConfig) but does not destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery. Preview context is silently dropped.
issues.suggestedFix: Destructure live_preview from the function parameters and pass it to createContentTypeQuery, identical to the fix for findSingletonEntry.
